definitions.explanation: A small square of terrycloth carried like a handkerchief, popular in Japan for drying the hands and wiping away sweat.

examples.japanese: タオルハンカチで{手|て}を{拭|ふ}いた。
examples.english: I wiped my hands with a towel handkerchief.

examples.japanese: {汗|あせ}をかいたのでタオルハンカチを{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I was sweating, so I took out my towel handkerchief.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{吸水性|きゅうすいせい}のいいタオルハンカチが{手放|てばな}せない。
examples.english: In summer I can't do without an absorbent towel handkerchief.

notes:
A wasei (Japanese-coined) compound of "towel" + "handkerchief"; thicker and more absorbent than a cloth handkerchief.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タオルハンカチで{拭|ふ}く: to wipe with a towel handkerchief
- タオルハンカチを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry a towel handkerchief around
- {厚手|あつで}のタオルハンカチ: a thick towel handkerchief
